# commander_classic_bank_account (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up a Keeper `bankAccount` (Bank Account) record by **UID**.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a bank account record by title or UID.
data "commander_classic_bank_account" "example" {
  account = "_REPLACE_WITH_RECORD_TITLE_OR_UID_"
}

output "bank_account_id" {
  value = data.commander_classic_bank_account.example.id
}

output "bank_account_title" {
  value = data.commander_classic_bank_account.example.title
}

output "bank_account_notes" {
  value = data.commander_classic_bank_account.example.notes
}

output "bank_account_folder_location" {
  value = data.commander_classic_bank_account.example.folder_location
}

output "bank_account_details" {
  value     = data.commander_classic_bank_account.example.bank_account
  sensitive = true
}

output "bank_account_name" {
  value = data.commander_classic_bank_account.example.name
}

output "bank_account_login" {
  value = data.commander_classic_bank_account.example.login
}

output "bank_account_password" {
  value     = data.commander_classic_bank_account.example.password
  sensitive = true
}

output "bank_account_website_address" {
  value = data.commander_classic_bank_account.example.website_address
}

output "bank_account_card_ref" {
  value = data.commander_classic_bank_account.example.card_ref
}

output "bank_account_custom" {
  value = data.commander_classic_bank_account.example.custom
}

output "bank_account_share" {
  value = data.commander_classic_bank_account.example.share
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account` (String) Bank Account record **title** or **UID** to look up.

### Read-Only

- `bank_account` (Attributes) Bank account details (`bankAccount` field). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--bank_account))
- `card_ref` (String) **UID** of a linked payment card record.
- `custom` (Attributes List) Custom fields stored in the record's `custom` array. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom))
- `folder_location` (String) Folder `path` or `UID` where the record is to be stored.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier (UID) of the vault record.
- `login` (String) **Username** or **login** identifier.
- `name` (Attributes) Person name (`name` field): first, middle, last. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--name))
- `notes` (String) Note of the record.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) **Password**.
- `share` (Attributes Map) Mapping of share permissions for this record. Each map **key** is a **user email**; each **value** is an object with `can_share` and `can_edit` booleans. The owner is implicit and never present in this map; the API rejects owner entries. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--share))
- `title` (String) Record title.
- `website_address` (String) **Website address**.

<a id="nestedatt--bank_account"></a>
### Nested Schema for `bank_account`

Read-Only:

- `account_number` (String, Sensitive) **Account number**.
- `account_type` (String) **Account type**.
- `other_type` (String) Description when **account_type** is **Other**.
- `routing_number` (String) Routing number.


<a id="nestedatt--custom"></a>
### Nested Schema for `custom`

Read-Only:

- `label` (String) Field label.
- `sensitive` (Boolean) Whether the value should be treated as **sensitive**.
- `type` (String) Keeper field **type** (e.g. `text`, `email`, `secret`).
- `value` (String, Sensitive) Field **value** (JSON-encoded for complex types).


<a id="nestedatt--name"></a>
### Nested Schema for `name`

Read-Only:

- `first` (String) **First name**.
- `last` (String) **Last name**.
- `middle` (String) **Middle name**.


<a id="nestedatt--share"></a>
### Nested Schema for `share`

Read-Only:

- `can_edit` (Boolean) Allow the user to edit this record. Defaults to `false`.
- `can_share` (Boolean) Allow the user to re-share this record with other users. Defaults to `false`.
